capture_run.source_surface: Google Trends web UI API endpoints (explore + widgetdata), in-page session (banked browser-route method)
capture_run.value_semantics: Google Trends 0-100 relative search-interest index, normalized per batch to the batch peak; not counts, sales, demand size, or population rates
capture_run.schema_note: mirrors the 2026-08-05 search_interest_series.json record shape and ADDS a 'property' field (web_search | shopping); this is the shape delta for the schema bootstrap
capture_run.cross_pull_note: separate normalization from the 2026-08-05 pull; cross-pull level comparison only through the shared anchor term and labeled approximate
capture_run.record_uniqueness: one record per (term, geo, window, property, batch_id)
